# graviteeam_password_policy_evaluation (Data Source)

Evaluates a password against a Gravitee AM domain password policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_domain" "example" {
  name        = "password-policy-evaluation-domain"
  description = "Domain for password policy evaluation example"

  oidc {}
  login_settings {}
}

resource "graviteeam_password_policy" "example" {
  domain_id  = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  name       = "Evaluation policy"
  min_length = 8
}

data "graviteeam_password_policy_evaluation" "example" {
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  policy_id = graviteeam_password_policy.example.id
  password  = "SecurePass123!"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password value to evaluate.
- `policy_id` (String) The ID of the password policy to evaluate. Use a concrete policy ID; the default policy alias is not reliable for this endpoint.

### Optional

- `user_id` (String) Optional user ID to include in the password evaluation request.

### Read-Only

- `result_json` (String) JSON string containing the password evaluation response.
